description: A large flag, made to fly in even the worst conditions.

variants.description: A large flag with three horizontal stripes of equal size: red, yellow, and deep purple from top to bottom.  The national flag of the Second Spanish Republic, the national arms is situated in the yellow stripe’s middle: a shield divided into quarters representing Castile, Leon, Aragon and Navarre.  Granada is represented at the shield’s point, with the whole surmounted by a mural crown and flanked by the twin pillars of Hercules interlaced with a ribbon bearing the legend 'Plus Ultra'.

name.str: battle standard of the International Brigades
name.str_pl: battle standards of the International Brigades

variants.description: A large, high-contrast flag featuring three equal sized horizontal stripes of red, yellow and deep purple.  In the middle, a red, 3-pointed star stands out against the yellow, marking the banner as the catch-all flag for international brigades fighting on behalf of Republican Spain.
